project.name: Mobile 3D Action Slice
project.summary: Compare serious runtimes against one shared playable mobile-3D action contract.

stages.label: Competing implementations
stages.nextAction: Stop opening additional shallow feasibility lanes for now. Consolidate the active runtime queue, advance execution-backed candidates toward the unchanged full Phase A contract, preserve failed/blocked evidence, and require exact-head proof before promotion.

stages.label: Automated QA
stages.nextAction: Retain revision-bound runtime evidence, including failures. Newly opened feasibility lanes are ownership-visible but remain execution-unknown here until exact-head artifacts are independently verified.

stages.label: Human playtest
stages.nextAction: Remains blocked until comparable candidate implementations and a human-launchable verified build exist.

stages.label: Compare & promote
stages.nextAction: Compare only validated candidates after human playtest; no engine winner is declared yet.

workstreams.title: Three.js/WebGPU Phase A candidate
workstreams.nextSafeAction: Integrated Phase A remains the accepted baseline. PR #99 is active follow-up work; retain prior revision-bound evidence and require fresh exact-head proof for the current PR head before promotion.

agents.objective: Keep lifecycle, Studio state and benchmark promotion revision-exact and evidence-gated while candidate work executes.
Advance execution-backed candidates toward comparable Phase A implementations while preserving failed/blocked lanes and the shared benchmark contract.
Bind execution claims to exact revisions, preserve failed/unknown lanes, and keep bounded, device and human evidence classes separate.

decisions.title: Use a shared playable contract across multiple serious runtimes
decisions.rationale: A shared playable slice produces evidence about production efficiency, player-facing quality, performance, deployment reliability, economics and maintainability.
